bridge_session.lifecycle: CREATED->RUNNING->OVER/FAILED/CLOSED; shutdown interrupts game thread + joins; terminal latch; abortParkedFrame; never fabricates outcome
bridge_session.revisions: frameSeq monotonic (AtomicLong); auditSeq monotonic; STALE_REVISION on parked-vs-recorded mismatch, no mutation
bridge_session.seed_install: BridgeSession.launch calls MyRandom.bindSeed(seed) on protocol thread before game thread shuffles/rolls; failure throws (fail closed); audit seed_bound event
